summary.text:
# 资源统合 / Resource Consolidation

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Synthetic Dawn · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`common/governments/civics/00_origins.txt:2533-2566`、`common/inline_scripts/game_start/origin_machine.txt`

> 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要机器智能；起始殖民地为机器世界，母星带有“原型机械”矿藏和两处“施工中”矿藏（吸收者政体另加有机浆液）。
Requires the machine-intelligence authority; the homeworld is a machine world with Prototype Machinery and two Ongoing Construction deposits (Driven Assimilators also get Organic Slurry).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

没有叙事窗口；通用事件 aquatics.105 有该起源的文本分支。
No story windows; the generic aquatics.105 has a text branch for this origin.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。 None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

可选条件见起源卡。 Requirements are on the origin card.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：起源定义、开局设置与全部事件目录中对该起源的引用。 The origin definition, its start setup and every reference to the origin in the events folder.
- 结论 Result：卡片型起源，没有专属事件窗口。 A card-only origin with no origin-specific windows.
